notes: PRINTING THAT COMES OUT RIGHT ON A4. Every document the app prints was printed and checked page by page. Vouchers, receipts, invoices, payslips and certificates print portrait; wide schedules print LANDSCAPE so no column is lost - WHT schedules, DT 110 (which printed 4 of its 13 columns), PAYE and SSNIT, the payroll register, the aged reports, budget control and the General Ledger. DT 0107A prints in two parts. SIGNATURES STAY WITH WHAT THEY SIGN: a one-line voucher fits one sheet instead of sending its signatures to a second page. The VAT return, Tourism Levy return and capital allowance schedule can now be printed. The official receipt has its signature lines, invoices show your GRA TIN, and emailed payslips and invoices are A4. Also new: an illustrated step-by-step USER GUIDE, and a pass over every screen - clearer confirmations, one date format, readable error messages. Installing: nothing in the ledger changes. Please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
